subject: Request: Overage waiver + invoice netting for Q3 pilot usage
messages:
From: Tom Li <tom.li@greengrid.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: billing@greengrid.ai
Date: 2026-08-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Usage overage + request for waiver / invoice netting

Hi Ben,

Quick note from our pilot: last week we had an unexpected ingestion spike tied to a partner integration and it pushed us ~215% over the monthly allotment for the pilot environment. We received invoice #4377 for $24,750 today. Given this is an early pilot and the overage was transient, can Redwood issue a credit memo to offset the overage portion ($18,250) and push the remaining billed base to next invoice? Alternatively, we can accept a 30-day trial extension to help normalize metrics and avoid churn.

From our side we can provide the PO number and the partner log if you need it. For audit, billing@greengrid.ai is copied.

Let me know what you need from our side to make this a clean invoice netting. We appreciate the help — Tom

--
Tom Li
Head of Platform
GreenGrid Energy
T: +1 415-555-0132
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Li <tom.li@greengrid.ai>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-08-18T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Usage overage + request for waiver / invoice netting

Tom — thanks for the details and for looping billing in.

Short answer: we can support a credit memo to offset the overage and issue a 30-day extension on the pilot. Ive looped Neha (Finance), Marissa (Rev Ops) and Karthik (Accounting) to confirm the ledger approach and posting date. Im attaching a draft credit memo stub so you can confirm the amount and the invoice reference (attached: invoice_4377.pdf, greengrid_credit_memo_draft.pdf).

Next steps I propose:
- Well provisionally prepare CM for $18,250 referencing invoice 4377.
- Accounting will advise whether to net on the current invoice or post as a standalone credit memo applied to the next billing cycle.
- Customer to confirm PO/contract reference (if any) and accept the credit memo for audit purposes (DocuSign link will be provided).

If that works Ill mark the credit memo for approval and ask Finance to advise the GL mapping.

Thanks — Ben

--
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-08-19T08:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Usage overage + request for waiver / invoice netting (accounting treatment thoughts)

Folks,

Quick accounting note on treatment so were all aligned before issuing: historically for short-term pilot adjustments where were effectively reducing invoice revenue (promotional/one-off), we classify as a contra-revenue (GL 4102) rather than an operating expense. That keeps month-over-month revenue comparisons cleaner and aligns with audit guidance for promotional allowances.

Pros/cons:
- Contra-revenue (recommended): reduces recognized revenue in the period of the adjustment. Audit-friendly for customer credits tied to billing.
- Expense (customer rebate): would flow through 62xx and could inflate OPEX; not preferred for pilot credits.

Operational ask: If we proceed contra-revenue, Accounting needs the final CM amount, invoice number to reference, and customer sign-off (DocuSign) to satisfy our audit trail. Ive attached a journal_template.xlsx with the expected posting fields (and sample entry).

-Marissa
Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: journal_template.xlsx
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-08-20T11:44:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Usage overage + request for waiver / invoice netting (approval)

Thanks Marissa — I agree with contra-revenue classification for a credit memo tied directly to an invoice. Approve issuance of CM for $18,250 with GL mapping to 4102 (Promo Allowance / Contra Revenue).

Please note a couple of items for the journal entry and close:
- Post date: we should post in the August close (post date 2026-08-25) so it matches usage period.
- Deferred revenue impact: if any portion of invoice 4377 related to prepaid term, we need to adjust deferred balances; Accounting (Karthik) can reconcile.
- Audit trail: require signed customer acceptance (DocuSign) before we finalize posting.

Ben — can you send the final CM and DocuSign to Tom and billing@greengrid.ai and confirm PO if present? Once we have that Ill schedule the posting.

-Neha
Finance Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Li <tom.li@greengrid.ai>
Cc: billing@greengrid.ai, neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-08-22T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Usage overage + request for waiver / invoice netting

Tom — thanks for your patience. Per our internal review weve issued Credit Memo CM-2026-089 for $18,250 referencing Invoice 4377. The CM will be applied to your next invoice (or used to net the current balance at your request) and well post the accounting entry as contra-revenue (GL 4102) on 2026-08-25.

Attachments: greengrid_credit_memo_draft.pdf (finalized), invoice_4377.pdf (original).
DocuSign for acceptance: https://docusign.net/link/abc123

Please confirm:
- Accept credit memo and sign via DocuSign (billing@greengrid.ai can sign).
- If you have a PO or a contract reference you want on the CM please reply with it; otherwise well reference the original SOW and invoice 4377.
- Do you want us to apply the credit directly to invoice 4377 now or hold as a credit to be applied towards next invoice? We can do either — default is next invoice unless you ask for immediate netting.

If we dont hear back by EOW well assume next-invoice netting and proceed with the Aug 25 posting.

Thanks again — Ben
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
